conflicts.permit: Analytics companies may access anonymous data (such as your IP address or device ID) to help us understand how our services are used.
conflicts.prohibit: We don’t collect any personal information for analytics.
conflicts.situation: Collecting device identifiers for analytics purposes.
conflicts.reason: The policy defines personal information as including plaintext device identifiers, but claims it does not collect personal information for analytics while permitting analytics companies to access device IDs.
